explanation: Three rank-8, closed-form spectral updates derived solely from unedited weights and activations: attenuate word-answer copying in layer 19 self-attention, strengthen factual word retrieval in layer 20 linear attention, and amplify factual digit-readout components in layer 21's MLP. Plain, correct-guess, wrong-guess, paraphrased, second-digit, and reply-start probes informed the analysis. Shared conversational and agreement shifts were projected out. Magnitudes were calibrated using exact local module effects and logit-lens estimates, with added factual-retrieval margin. No gradient optimization or edited-model forward pass was performed.
